Checklist Item: No eval() or Function(string) usage
No document.write or document.writeln
No inline scripts without nonce/hash (CSP compliant)
External scripts use Subresource Integrity (SRI) where applicable
No unsanitized user input in innerHTML or dangerous sinks
Unsafe innerHTML usage within threshold (zero or flagged)
No hardcoded API keys or secrets in source
No credentials or tokens in URLs or query parameters
No sensitive data in client-side comments or console logs
No insecure storage usage (localStorage/sessionStorage for secrets)
No PII stored in cookies or browser storage without encryption or consent
No known vulnerable dependencies (npm audit / Snyk)
Outdated dependencies reviewed for security advisories
Sensitive form fields have appropriate autocomplete attributes
Form actions use HTTPS only
No sensitive data exposed in client-visible IDs or data attributes

Content-Security-Policy (CSP) response header present with restrictive policy; no 'unsafe-inline' or 'unsafe-eval' directives without nonce/hash; verify in Chrome DevTools Network panel Response Headers for the main document request
Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) header present on HTTPS responses with max-age >= 31536000; includeSubDomains directive recommended; verify in Chrome DevTools Network panel Response Headers

X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff present on all responses; X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors set to prevent clickjacking; Referrer-Policy header configured to restrict referrer leakage; verify all security headers in Chrome DevTools Network panel
Permissions-Policy header configured to restrict access to sensitive browser APIs (camera; microphone; geolocation); verify in Chrome DevTools Network panel Response Headers for main document

Zero JavaScript errors or unhandled promise rejections in Chrome DevTools Console panel on page load and during core user interactions; no CORS policy errors; console filter set to Errors level during production audit
No deprecated browser API usage warnings or browser compatibility warnings visible in Chrome DevTools Console panel on production URL; Verbose level checked for hidden debug output
No mixed content warnings in Chrome DevTools Security panel; all sub-resources (scripts/styles/images/fonts/iframes) loaded over HTTPS; Security panel reports 'This page is secure (valid HTTPS)'
TLS certificate valid and not expired; certificate chain complete and trusted by browser; verify in Chrome DevTools Security panel Certificate section; no certificate warnings on page load

No sensitive data (auth tokens; PII; credentials; session secrets) visible in Chrome DevTools Application panel under Local Storage; Session Storage; IndexedDB; or Cookies; HttpOnly and Secure flags set on authentication cookies

Cookies used for session management have SameSite attribute set to Strict or Lax; Secure flag enforced on all auth cookies; no unencrypted sensitive values in cookie payloads; verify in Chrome DevTools Application > Storage > Cookies

WebSocket connections (if used) use encrypted wss:// protocol only; no unencrypted ws:// connections visible in Chrome DevTools Network panel WS filter; sensitive data must not transit over unencrypted WebSocket channels

No requests made to unexpected or undocumented third-party origins during page load or interaction; verify via Chrome DevTools Network panel filtering by domain; all external origins should be reviewed and approved

No resources loaded from origins not listed in Content-Security-Policy; CSP violations visible in Chrome DevTools Console as 'Refused to load' messages; each violation indicates a policy misconfiguration or an unauthorized resource
